newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Blow out vs the bloc.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Blow out vs the bloc.

text.p: Technical selling and indications that the pace of the Australian economy was healthier than anticipated saw domestic bond yield spreads to the dollar bloc blow out.
The Australian/U.S. 10-year spread was testing 110 basis points, its highest level since the beginning of the year, and an earlier tightening to Canada was reversed.
There was no impact within the dollar bloc from the death of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.
An unexpected 8.6 percent jump in December quarter company profits weighed heavily on the local market and in turn triggered computerised technical selling, traders said.

"We expect to see some good buying from London at 110 basis points (versus the U.S.), but with the current mood of the market could see this widen further to 115 (basis points)," one trader at a European based bank said.
Although some switching to the Australian dollar from the Canadian unit was seen in after hours trading following Tuesday's Canadian budget, the impact on spreads proved short-lived.
The weakness of domestic bonds also dragged on New Zealand debt, but the latter outperformed and the 10-year spread went to a premium from a discount.
